players.product: BUZZ HPC GPU cloud (NVIDIA GB200 / GB300 / B200 / H200 clusters in Bell AI Fabric data centers in Canada) plus HPC colocation conversions of owned sites (Boden Sweden, Toronto gigafactory)

quarterly_data.signal: HIVE's 8-K: BUZZ HPC entered a strategic partnership with ProCogia, a Vancouver-based applied-AI and data engineering company: ProCogia will procure dedicated GPU capacity from BUZZ HPC's Canadian data centers to power its own AI products (its ZeroBoxx AI framework, with the CallYeah and PolyKode vertical products as anchor workloads) and client workloads, and will serve as a preferred applied-AI services partner to BUZZ HPC's customers; the two intend to co-sell in the United States and Europe. The release lists BUZZ HPC's expansion over the past twelve months, including a 4x expansion of liquid-cooled AI data-center capacity in British Columbia and a 320 MW sovereign AI infrastructure build-out in the Greater Toronto Area; Executive Chairman Frank Holmes cites a 400 MW coast-to-coast Canadian pipeline.
quarterly_data.figure: no specific figure for the ProCogia agreement; 4x British Columbia liquid-cooled capacity; 320 MW Greater Toronto Area build-out; 400 MW Canadian pipeline
